d.ko:
Deep snow snowmobiling with real physics.
Ride licensed sleds from Lynx, Polaris, and Ski-Doo across massive open backcountry maps. Find your own lines, climb steep mountains, ride with friends online, and chase the perfect run in untouched powder.

d.zh: 这是一款自由骑行雪地摩托模拟游戏，操控手感和真车一样。深雪物理逼你把车压到一侧、反打车把，才能爬坡、横切侧坡、在林间压弯。叫上好友在线骑 Arctic Cat、Lynx、Polaris 和 Ski-Doo 正版授权雪地摩托。

rv.t: Really fun game but please add more sleds from the 1990s. I hope arctic cat sleds can make their return some day to.
The idea of this game is pretty sick. The problem is there is absolutely no objective other than ride around, that gets stale FAST. Controls also feel extremely clunky. 3/5
I was interested in this one. Sadly, it's one of those sandbox-type games where you load into a map and then you're supposed to create your own fun. I really hate that. …
游戏没有中文，但基本用不上。驾驶雪地摩托自由驰骋，如果不掌握操作技巧，一旦驶入粉雪，你不是陷在雪里，就是在不停地挪车，压根没机会享受真正的“驰骋”。
雪地摩托模拟佳作，深雪下陷、重心偏移、悬挂回弹、侧坡打滑高度还原真机手感，油门控制、身体配重决定行驶状态。穿越粉雪、陡坡攀爬、悬崖飞坡的沉浸感拉满。 …
